input.quote: (e) not use the Work except as authorized herein;
input.rationale: Searches for audit, inspection, verification, records, monitoring, access and premises language return no right for Garman to audit, inspect or verify Sparkling's use of the Software. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use), Section 14 (Confidentiality) and Section 20 (General Matters) impose use restrictions and confidentiality duties but confer no verification or system-access right against us, and Section 20 contains no audit mechanic. The only examination right in the document (p0114, source code escrow) runs in our favour, permitting Sparkling or its independent experts to examine and test escrowed materials for Garman's compliance. Because no audit right binds the Customer, the position is better than the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost, no system access), so there is nothing to limit and no redline is warranted. No fallback reliance is needed; the absence of a Vendor audit right benefits us and should not be flagged or invited by proposing audit language.
